name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart and verified a chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API.

Steps completed:
1. Fetched the quickstart page from https://docs.fireworks.ai/getting-started/quickstart
2. Verified the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable was already exported in the sandbox
3. Installed/verified the OpenAI Python SDK was available (pip install openai)
4. Created the Python script at /home/daytona/quickstart.py following the quickstart's OpenAI SDK example
5. The model specified in the quickstart (accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1) returned a 404 Not Found error
6. Queried the available models via the API and selected an available chat model (accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro)
7. Ran the script and successfully received the chat completion response: "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart specifies model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1" which returned a 404 error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to query the available models endpoint and substitute an available model ("accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro") to make the API call succeed. This is a deviation from the exact quickstart code example.
